equality: Exact source arithmetic owns face/edge equality at edge and edge/apex equality at apex. Floating raw comparisons use no tie epsilon. Near-boundary rounded classifier may choose either adjacent branch; no unique boundary classical tangent or bit-identical branch across backends is claimed. Stress still must satisfy prospective accuracy/admissibility gates.
derivatives: Differentiate only selected ordinary spectral branch; value-only classification is control, not a numeric derivative. Isolated projectors and paired sums preserve valid complementary repeated spectra. Apex stress derivatives are zero but parameter c/phi derivatives are not generally zero.
failure: No clipping, eigenvalue merging, branch retry or fallback on spectral failure. Nonfinite intermediates, unresolved selected gaps, negative selected multipliers or failed checks cause rejected evaluation; caller must discard scratch and retain committed state.

yield_allowance.meaning: Initial admissibility and returned yield use F<=256*eps*max(h,abs(lambda_max),abs(lambda_min)); this is numerical roundoff allowance only, no projection or change to strict elastic classifier.

source_only_certificate_gate.scale: max(1 Pa,c,Cartesian Frobenius norm of source trial and expected return)
source_only_certificate_gate.scope: Bounded 14 analytical certificates under binary64 parameter/Mandel conversion; not full numerical-domain or derivative verification.

representability: Positive finite moduli/cohesion, resolved 0<sin(phi),sin(psi)<1 and positive denominators. Overflow/underflow can reject mathematically valid unresolved inputs; no full source-domain executable claim.
next_gate: Independent exact-stored-input full tensor value/38-column directional references with rotations, near-boundaries, parameter sensitivity and failure/rollback requests must be frozen before compiled model study.

parent.outcome: failed four zero-increment hold cases, preserved unchanged

arithmetic_revision.meaning: Exact source algebra rearranged to share yield residual and nonnegative gaps. At hydrostatic trial gamma_apex=Ftrial/da. No change to classifier inequalities, strict elastic threshold, stress formulas, independent reference, acceptance bound or spectral gap policy; no clipping/fallback.
